newsitem.title: USA: CHS Electronics to acquire four companies.
newsitem.headline: CHS Electronics to acquire four companies.

text.p: CHS Electronics Inc said on Wednesday it has signed definitive agreements to buy four privately held distribution companies doing business in South America and Eastern Europe.
The companies are being purchased for a combination of stock and cash, CHS said.
The acquisitions had combined 1996 revenues of $88 million and are expected to add $120 million to CHS revenues on a proforma basis in 1997, the company said.
CHS Electrics said the acquisitions are expected to boost net income.

The company is acquiring Ameritech Exports Inc, a Miami-based distributor of Compaq products throughout South America; Ameritech Argentina SA, a microcomputer distributor based in Buenos Aires; CompExpress Informatica Ltda, an IBM distributor in Brazil; and Atlantis Skupina, a microcomputer products distributor in Slovenia.
Specific terms of the acquisitions were not disclosed.
CompExpress and Atlantis Skupina are being acquired through earn-outs based on future financial performance, CHS said.
